feedback.problem:
If $f(x)$ is continuous at $x=5$ and $f(5)=2,$ then what is the value of

$$
{lim}_{x\to 5}\sqrt{{x}^{3}-25f(x)}\,?
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We're told that $f(x)$ is continuous at $x=5.$ According to the definition of continuity, this means that ${lim}_{x\to 5}f(x)$ exists and

$$
{lim}_{x\to 5}f(x)=f(5)=2.
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to 5}\sqrt{{x}^{3}-25f(x)} & =\sqrt{{5}^{3}-25\cdot 2} \\  & =\sqrt{75} \\  & =5\sqrt{3}.\end{aligned}
$$
